newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Korea Int'l Merchant Bk mandates FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Korea Int'l Merchant Bk mandates FRCD.

text.p: Korea International Merchant Bank has mandated Commerz (East Asia) to arrange a US$70 million three-year floating rate certificates of deposit issue, the arranger said on Friday.
Cho Hung Bank and WestLB Asia Pacific have joined as underwriters.
Syndication will begin after obtaining the approval of the Ministry of Finance.

The borrower launched a US$60 million floating rate note issue in April that gave an all-in return of 60 basis points to top-tier managers and a US$50 million FRCD issue in July that gave an all-in return of 62 basis points.
Both deals carried a maturity of five years with a three-year put option.
